ops.title: cc-pane: SSE streams instead of polling
ops.description: Deferred from the cc-pane v1 plan (v1 auto-polls fleet.status ~2s and re-fetches the notes graph). Switch the fleet feed to cco's SSE event stream (fleet.status already returns the resume seq) and the timeline to cc-notes viz /api/stream, keeping the pollers as fallback. Removes poll latency and cuts idle load.
